slots.name: name
slots.label: Project Name
slots.description: Add project/task name column. This will be displayed in the left panel hierarchy.

slots.name: row
slots.label: Project ID
slots.description: Add unique project ID column. Used to identify projects and build hierarchy relationships.

slots.name: category
slots.label: Category Type
slots.description: Add category column (organization, epic, story, deal). Used to determine hierarchy level and visual styling.

slots.name: levels
slots.label: Parent ID
slots.description: Add parent ID column to define hierarchy relationships. References another project's ID to create parent-child structure. Leave null for top-level items.

slots.name: slidermetric
slots.label: Client
slots.description: Add client name column. Displayed on organization-level items in the left panel.

slots.name: time
slots.label: Start Date
slots.description: Add start date column for timeline positioning. Must be datetime type.

slots.name: evolution
slots.label: End Date
slots.description: Add end date column for timeline bar length. Must be datetime type.

slots.name: identifier
slots.label: Status
slots.description: Add status column (active, at risk, completed, in planning, pipeline). Displayed as colored circle on timeline bars.

slots.name: dimension
slots.label: Assignee
slots.description: Add assignee name column. Displayed as initials in glass pill badge on timeline bars.

slots.name: color
slots.label: Color Code
slots.description: Add color code column (PURPLE, ORANGE, GREEN, GRAY). Determines timeline bar color.

slots.name: measure
slots.label: Hours Billed
slots.description: Add hours billed column (numeric). Used to calculate progress percentage and display on bars.

slots.name: columns
slots.label: Hours Estimated
slots.description: Add hours estimated column (numeric). Displayed in hours badge on timeline bars.

slots.name: size
slots.label: Hours Budgeted
slots.description: Add hours budgeted column (numeric). Used to calculate progress percentage and two-shade bar visualization.
